english.title: Knowingly / recklessly make a misleading, false or deceptive statement when requesting to inspect / copy a PSC register
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowingly or recklessly made a statement that was misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..) in a request under section 790O of the Companies Act 2006 to inspect or require a copy of part of or all of the PSC register of **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790R(1) and (3) of the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes: Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.
